nodes.description: Apply the properties of operations to generate equivalent expressions.
nodes.label: 6.EE.A.3

nodes.description: Apply properties of operations as strategies to add and subtract.* Examples: If 8 + 3 = 11 is known, then 3 + 8 = 11 is also known. (Commutative property of addition.) To add 2 + 6 + 4, the second two numbers can be added to make a ten, so 2 + 6 + 4 = 2 + 10 = 12. (Associative property of addition.) *Students need not use formal terms for these properties.
nodes.label: 1.OA.B.3

nodes.description: Find the greatest common factor of two whole numbers less than or equal to 100 and the least common multiple of two whole numbers less than or equal to 12. Use the distributive property to express a sum of two whole numbers 1–100 with a common factor as a multiple of a sum of two whole numbers with no common factor. For example, express 36 + 8 as 4 (9 + 2).
nodes.label: 6.NS.B.4

nodes.description: Write simple expressions that record calculations with numbers, and interpret numerical expressions without evaluating them. For example, express the calculation “add 8 and 7, then multiply by 2” as 2 × (8 + 7). Recognize that 3 × (18932 + 921) is three times as large as 18932 + 921, without having to calculate the indicated sum or product.
nodes.label: 5.OA.A.2

nodes.description: Write, read, and evaluate expressions in which letters stand for numbers.
nodes.label: 6.EE.A.2

nodes.description: Apply properties of operations as strategies to multiply and divide.* Examples: If 6 × 4 = 24 is known, then 4 × 6 = 24 is also known. (Commutative property of multiplication.) 3 × 5 × 2 can be found by 3 × 5 = 15, then 15 × 2 = 30, or by 5 × 2 = 10, then 3 × 10 = 30. (Associative property of multiplication.) Knowing that 8 × 5 = 40 and 8 × 2 = 16, one can find 8 × 7 as 8 × (5 + 2) = (8 × 5) + (8 × 2) = 40 + 16 = 56. (Distributive property.) *Students need not use formal terms for these properties.
nodes.label: 3.OA.B.5

set.name: Equations and Their Solutions

set.description: 只含一个未知数、未知数的次数为 1 且等号两边都是整式的方程叫一元一次方程。
set.name: The Concept of a Linear Equation in One Unknown

set.reason: The linear-equation form offers a useful contrast in highest degree. A degree-two polynomial equation can be defined and classified from general equation and polynomial meanings directly.
set.scope: defining and identifying quadratic equations

set.reason: To judge whether something is a quadratic equation, a student must first know what makes an expression an equation. The quadratic classification refines that basic equation concept.
set.scope: recognizing a quadratic equation as an equation

set.reason: The quadratic formula motivates the discriminant, while the completed-square form establishes the same root-count signs without writing or evaluating the formula. Keep preparation.
set.scope: justifying the role of b^2-4ac

set.reason: Common-factor extraction is one factoring route. Other equations use identities instead, so this is not an AND prerequisite for every factoring-method item. Root checked both endpoint-based reviews; each identifies the stated content or conditional method rather than a curriculum-order claim.
set.scope: Exposing a zero product by extracting a common factor from the polynomial equation

set.reason: The target procedure needs a zero-product equation and factoring, not the separate ability to name quadratic/linear/constant coefficients. Its source criterion does not ask for prior classification.
set.scope: The quadratic-equation classification framework around factorization solving

set.reason: A discriminant check guards real-root assumptions in parameter questions. A problem that already gives real roots can use Vieta's relations directly, so this is useful preparation.
set.scope: checking real roots in parameter problems

set.reason: The actual criterion explicitly derives the sum/product identities from the quadratic formula, so that specific formula-based derivation is within required scope.
set.scope: deriving sum and product of roots

criteria: 能由 Δ 判断根的个数
set.description: Δ=b²-4ac 决定根的情况：Δ>0 两个不等实根，Δ=0 两个相等实根，Δ<0 无实根。
set.name: The Discriminant

criteria: 能指出二次项系数、一次项系数和常数项
set.description: 只含一个未知数、未知数最高次数为 2 的整式方程叫一元二次方程，一般形式 ax²+bx+c=0（a≠0）。
set.name: Concept of a Quadratic Equation in One Variable

set.description: 把方程一边化为 0，另一边分解成一次因式的积，利用“若 ab=0 则 a=0 或 b=0”求解。
set.name: Factoring Method
scopeNotes: Factoring here is an equation-solving procedure, not the entire factor-sign method for inequalities.

criteria: 提取后括号内项数不变
set.description: 找出各项的公因式（系数的最大公约数与相同字母最低次幂），提到括号外。
set.name: Factoring Out the Common Factor

criteria: 能由求根公式推出关系
set.description: 若 x₁、x₂ 是 ax²+bx+c=0 的两根，则 x₁+x₂=-b/a，x₁x₂=c/a（课标仅要求“了解”，见例67）。
set.name: Relationship Between the Roots and Coefficients of a Quadratic Equation in One Variable (Extension)
set.nameZh: 一元二次方程根与系数的关系（拓展）

criteria: 能正确代入求解并化简
set.description: 由配方法推出求根公式 x=(-b±√(b²-4ac))/(2a)（b²-4ac≥0），并用其解方程。
set.name: Formula Method and the Quadratic Formula
